svg.text: Submission gate after staged hygiene cleanup and UE 5.5 discovery correction
Pending set was not ready to submit
Staged diff check exposed five whitespace-only artifacts:
two trailing-space lines in the Day 47 plan and three extra blank lines at C++ file ends.
The manual engine check also missed the installed root under /Volumes/M2/Engine/UE_5.5.
Submission gates are clean and reproducible
Whitespace-only artifacts removed; staged diff check passes.
BuildEditor.command autodiscovers /Volumes/M2/Engine/UE_5.5 and deploys AuraEditor Mac Development.
Workspace Python supplies Pillow; Day 41–60 contract and content gates all pass.
Evidence: Day 41 90/90 · Days 42–58 50/50 · Day 59 5/5 · Day 60 8/8 · content 22/22 · build PASS · worktree clean after commit
